bottom_line: At the latest retrieved spot quote near $3,569.70, gold is below the $3,589.38 confirmation level for the reversal and inside the $3,558–$3,589 decision zone. Base case: choppy consolidation with downside risk while $3,589.38 caps. A clean break below $3,526.83 raises the chance of retesting $3,500 and $3,426.80. A sustained reclaim of $3,589.38 strengthens the bounce; clearing $3,689.87 would open $3,787.76–$3,872.94. Do not treat either direction as confirmed in holiday-thin conditions.
